text:
maria_ae: Opening Stargate POC thread. Customer acceptance asks: sustain 600 qps, p95 < 140ms, and clear KMS/HSM behaviour for compliance. Need short runbook, smoke numbers, and a POC hourly estimate.
owen_eng: Recommend rdx-3b-quant on dedicated capacity. Payloads ~320 tokens in, ~110 out. Plan: 10m warmup, 30m steady, 5m spike to 900 qps.
tess_sre: I'll size cluster: start with 10 nodes. Warmup script ready: `./warmup --prefix 8k --clients 20 --duration 10m`. Use Poisson arrivals from 3 generators.
ira_sec: For KMS: we'll demonstrate three modes: no-encrypt, envelope-cache, and strict-unwrap. Prep a short FAQ entry for the customer explaining audit logs and rotation.
ops-bot: perf-job-stargate-4765432100 started on cluster-dedicated-2.
owen_eng: Smoke run (warm cache): baseline p95 ~ 105ms, cached-envelope p95 ~ 132ms, unwrap-every-request p95 ~ 180ms. Throughput stable at 600 qps.
maria_ae: Can someone convert perf delta to cost? Customer wants $/1M tokens and hourly POC cost.
tess_sre: Rough cost sketch: node example $2.75/hr -> 10 nodes = $27.50/hr. Cached-envelope approx +15% compute overhead -> ~+$0.12 per 1M tokens. Strict-unwrap ~+38% -> ~+$0.34 per 1M tokens. I'll produce a short addendum.
ira_sec: Draft security blurb: "Customer CMKs remain in their KMS/HSM. Redwood uses envelope encryption; envelope keys cached per-node for performance. Unwrap events are logged and can be forwarded to customer's audit endpoint. Support for FIPS/HSM attestation available on Private deployments."
maria_ae: Action items: owen to upload artifacts (fortio/vegeta + metrics), tess to confirm node config and warmup script, ira to paste QA snippet and audit forward steps, tess to produce POC hourly estimate. I'll send to the customer once all artifacts land. :thumbsup:
